projects.title: Regulatory Copilot
projects.description: On-premise AI coding assistant for regulated software development, combining Qwen2.5-Coder 14B, vLLM, Continue and read-only MCP retrieval. README reports 5/5 retrieval test cases passed.

projects.title: AI RAG Agent with Persistent Memory
projects.description: Document-grounded assistant with local embeddings, ChromaDB retrieval, PDF/TXT/Markdown indexing, source attribution and persistent conversation memory. Chat uses the Moonshot AI API.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Pharmacy Night-Shift Scheduling
projects.description: Factor-graph DCOP scheduling with Max-Sum message passing and dynamic repair. The Bologna-grounded synthetic scenario reports a Jain fairness index of 0.9899.

projects.title: Wind Turbine Predictive Maintenance
projects.description: SCADA-based anomaly detection, missing-data robustness and simulated maintenance decisions. Documented farm-specific ROC-AUC scores include 0.858 and 0.740.

projects.title: AG News Text Classification
projects.description: Four-class news classification using TF-IDF and classical ML models on 127,600 articles; reported best test accuracy 92.80% with Linear SVM.

projects.title: Incremental Learning for Remote Sensing Images
projects.description: Master’s thesis at Beihang University exploring incremental learning for remote sensing image classification.
projects.stack: Remote Sensing · Incremental Learning · Computer Vision

projects.title: Person Detection Using LiDAR Point Clouds
projects.description: Bachelor’s thesis at Beihang University focused on person detection from 3D LiDAR point-cloud data.
